title: Doppler-induced tunable and shape-preserving frequency conversion of microwave wave packets
summary: In superconducting electronics, the ability to control the frequency of microwave wave packets is crucial for several applications, such as the operation of superconducting quantum processors and the readout of superconducting sensors. We introduce a new approach to microwave frequency conversion that harnesses a dynamic Doppler effect induced by a propagating front that separates regions of different phase velocities.
